video_title: Gilbert Arenas reveals he ALMOST teammed up with Dwyane Wade 🤯

quotes.speaker: Gilbert Arenas
quotes.summary_phrase: Gilbert Arenas on his short stint with the Golden State Warriors

text_blocks.speaker: Tony Allen
text_blocks.text: Why do you think the stint was so short in Golden State?

text_blocks.speaker: Gilbert Arenas
text_blocks.text: Couldn't afford me. I was most improved, averaging 18. Nobody ever did that. The most that was paid by a second rounder that played two years was like 42, which was mid-level. No one overpaid the mid-level. What I did in that time frame, most improved, averaging 18, they were like, 'Wait, hold on, we can't afford him.' Basically, it was either take a bad deal, sign a one-year deal for 4.9, and then I had like a seven-year, 79 million waiting, or hit free agency and see my value.

quotes.social_post: Gilbert Arenas explains why his time with the Warriors was so short saying the team simply could not afford him after his Most Improved Player season

quotes.speaker: Gilbert Arenas
quotes.summary_phrase: Gilbert Arenas on his role and value with the Washington Wizards
quotes.excerpt: when they need a bucket at the end, they're going through me
quotes.quote: Technically, I am a second rounder, but this is my team. I know we have a max player on this, but as long as I get the outlet, I can pass in the ball later. Antoine Jamison is the first option, but when they need a bucket at the end, they're going through me. It was me and Earl Boykins. We were shooting all the shots at the end of the game. When I went to free agency, it was more like I want to stay here because I know what the offense is. Going somewhere else, I don't know what it is. I don't know if they're going to let me play the same style.
quotes.social_post: Gilbert Arenas reflects on his time with the Wizards and his role as the go to scorer in crunch time despite the presence of other stars

quotes.speaker: Gilbert Arenas
quotes.summary_phrase: Gilbert Arenas on the Miami Heat's interest in his free agency
quotes.excerpt: we want to try him at the one
quotes.quote: Miami was free. Miami was like, 'We want you, but we don't want you for the ticket you're asking for.' But we just drafted a kid named Darius Miles. We want to try him at the one. But having y'all at the one, two, we kind of like that. We might want somebody probably bigger or something. So Lamar Odom was a free agent too. So Lamar was the number one free agent. I think I was two. So he was waiting for me to sign so he can get more than me. I'm trying to have him sign so I can get under him.
quotes.social_post: Gilbert Arenas reveals the Miami Heat were interested in him during free agency but were prioritizing Darius Miles at the point guard spot

quotes.speaker: Gilbert Arenas
quotes.summary_phrase: Gilbert Arenas on his decision to leave the Golden State Warriors
quotes.excerpt: Jason Richardson fought for me to start and play
quotes.quote: I wanted to stay because I trained with these guys. We came out of college. Jason Richardson fought for me to start and play, so those are my brothers. But I had to have the James Harden joint. Get on the phone and sign that big one. I didn't even realize that I'm rich. I was broke so long. I was pouring in the NBA. College, I was the man. When I got to the NBA, I was penny-pinching. I already spent my money, so I needed the two years. From there, I got to spend 500 a month. That was my free money.
quotes.social_post: Gilbert Arenas opens up about his early NBA financial struggles and why he had to chase the big contract to stop penny pinching
